import pandas as pd

# List of source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_0/training_0.csv",

    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_0/training_2.csv",

    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_0/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_0/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_0/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_0/training_7.csv"
]

# Target schema columns in order
target_columns = [
    'movie_display_name',
    'movie_production_year',
    'movie_genre_display_name',
    'movie_financial_summary_production_budget',
    'movie_financial_summary_international_box_office',
    'movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold',
    'movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units',
    'movie_acting_role_display_name',
    'movie_theatrical_release_release_date',
    'movie_creative_type_display_name',
    'movie_production_method_display_name',
    'movie_source_display_name',
    'movie_running_time',
    'movie_technical_role_display_name',
    'movie_production_company_display_name',
    'movie_sequel'
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema and in the same order
    # All source schemas are identical and match target columns by name and order
    df = df[target_columns]
    dfs.append(df)

# UNION operation: concatenate all source DataFrames vertically
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure data types match target schema types:
# According to target schema:
# string columns: movie_display_name, movie_genre_display_name, movie_acting_role_display_name,
# movie_theatrical_release_release_date, movie_creative_type_display_name,
# movie_production_method_display_name, movie_source_display_name,
# movie_technical_role_display_name, movie_production_company_display_name
# integer columns: movie_production_year, movie_financial_summary_production_budget,
# movie_financial_summary_international_box_office, movie_sequel
# float columns: movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold, movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units,
# movie_running_time

# Convert columns to appropriate types

# String columns - convert to string, fill NaN with empty string or keep NaN as is
string_cols = [
    'movie_display_name',
    'movie_genre_display_name',
    'movie_acting_role_display_name',
    'movie_theatrical_release_release_date',
    'movie_creative_type_display_name',
    'movie_production_method_display_name',
    'movie_source_display_name',
    'movie_technical_role_display_name',
    'movie_production_company_display_name'
]
for col in string_cols:
    target_df[col] = target_df[col].astype(str).replace('nan', pd.NA)

# Integer columns - convert to Int64 (nullable integer) to allow NaNs if any
int_cols = [
    'movie_production_year',
    'movie_financial_summary_production_budget',
    'movie_financial_summary_international_box_office',
    'movie_sequel'
]
for col in int_cols:
    target_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(target_df[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

# Float columns - convert to float
float_cols = [
    'movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold',
    'movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units',
    'movie_running_time'
]
for col in float_cols:
    target_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(target_df[col], errors='coerce').astype(float)

# Export the final DataFrame to CSV
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_0/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
